name: Saw Swarm
author: Emilie Gillet
description: Braids' seven-voice detuned sawtooth chorus, soft-clipped and carved by a resonant filter tracking the note. A fixed chorus, not the granular cloud Plaits' own Swarm engine is, and deliberately raw, aliasing sawtooths.

controls.label: Color
controls.description: The filter's cutoff: on the note a third of the way up, closing below that twice as fast as it opens above.

controls.label: Detune
controls.description: Spreads the seven saws apart in pitch, from unison to a wide, wavering chorus.

controls.label: Filter
controls.description: Sweeps the same filter's response from lowpass, through the module's own highpass at center, to bandpass.

controls.label: Resonance
controls.description: The filter's resonance, fixed in the module -- calmer below center, a controlled peak above it.

outputs.main: The filtered swarm at the dialed-in Filter position.
outputs.aux: The same swarm through the mirrored filter position, always the tap MAIN is not favouring.
